subject: ENGLISH
title: Be-Verb Team · M01 D11
objective: Choose am, is, are, was, or were to agree with the subject and time.
introduction: Use I am; he, she, or it is; you, we, or they are. For past time use was or were with the matching subject. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: An action word, like run, jump, or sing.
The part of a sentence that tells who or what.
The time that has already happened.
